# Test fixtures for mrpheus physlog functions
#
# These CSV files are generated by running the original MATLAB pipeline on the
# synthetic Philips PMU log bundled at inst/extdata/example_physlog.log,
# providing reference outputs for bit-perfect comparison against the R port.
#
# To generate, run from the mrpheus package root:
#
#   matlab -batch "run data-raw/generate_matlab_fixtures.m"
#
# Or interactively in MATLAB:
#   cd /path/to/mrpheus
#   run data-raw/generate_matlab_fixtures.m
#
# Requires ReadPhilipsScanPhysLog.m and pan_tompkin.m from neonatal_qrs.
# Edit NEONATAL_QRS_PATH in the script if your clone is elsewhere.
#
# Files generated:
#   fixture_C_first100.csv      first 100 rows of signal matrix (10 channels)
#   fixture_C_last100.csv       last 100 rows of signal matrix
#   fixture_scanner_start.csv   ScannerStart sample indices
#   fixture_scanner_stop.csv    ScannerStop sample indices
#   fixture_vcg_onset.csv       VcgOnset (ECG trigger) sample indices
#   fixture_qrs_i_raw.csv       R-peak indices from pan_tompkin.m
#   fixture_qrs_amp_raw.csv     R-peak amplitudes from pan_tompkin.m
#
# Tests that depend on fixtures use skip_if(!fixture_exists(name)) and are
# silently skipped until the fixtures are present.
